queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database(),current_user,session_user,pg_postmaster_start_time(),host(inet_server_addr()),inet_server_port(),current_setting('transaction_read_only'),current_setting('transaction_isolation'),current_setting('statement_timeout'),current_setting('lock_timeout'),current_setting('idle_in_transaction_session_timeout'),current_setting('TimeZone'),current_setting('DateStyle'),(SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()),rolsuper,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname<>current_user AND pg_has_role(current_user,oid,'MEMBER')),(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') AND c.relowner=current_user::regrole),has_table_privilege(current_user,'football.players','INSERT'),has_table_privilege(current_user,'ingest.schema_migrations','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') OR has_any_column_privilege(current_user,'ingest.schema_migrations','INSERT,UPDATE') FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user

queries.name: catalogue
queries.sql: Frozen real_v2.catalogue(conn, False): native catalogue SQL with exact target roles

queries.name: journal
queries.sql: SELECT version,content_sha256,applied_at::text,code_commit FROM ingest.schema_migrations ORDER BY version LIMIT 5

queries.name: journal_native
queries.sql: Frozen real_v2.journal_native(conn), exact four-row RR snapshot

queries.name: bootstrap_native
queries.sql: SELECT ROW(s.*)::text FROM ingest.dataset_snapshots s WHERE transform_version='bootstrap_v1' ORDER BY id LIMIT 2

queries.name: sequence_metadata_and_privileges
queries.sql: SELECT s.schemaname||'.'||s.sequencename,s.increment_by,s.cycle,s.cache_size,has_sequence_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'USAGE'),has_sequence_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT') FROM pg_sequences s JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=s.schemaname JOIN pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=s.sequencename WHERE s.schemaname IN ('ingest','football','analytics') ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 68
